clue.text: Rising movement winning hearts in expectation

parts.note: a side that is ahead is up

indicators.note: the hearts card symbol is placed within the word for expectation

parts.note: trust is confident expectation, as in hopeful reliance
H is the card-suit abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: A rising trend as hopes are won over by sentiment.
explanation.definitionFit: An upthrust is an upward push, as of rock in geology, so it is a rising movement.

clue.text: Who'll do fixing of hair netting for queen

taken as written
ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.definitionFit: A performer is one who does or carries out an act, so 'who'll do' describes the person cryptically.

clue.text: Artist taking husband round historic garden

explanation.walkthrough: William Hogarth was the 18th-century English painter of A Rake's Progress.
explanation.definitionFit: Hogarth is a famous English painter and engraver, an example of an artist.

clue.text: Pawnbroker's corrupt removing article

explanation.definitionFit: Uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker, from the pawnshop customer's euphemism of visiting a relative.

clue.text: Cask needing air to remove last of ale

clue.text: Person in court is restrained over argument

parts.note: plain as in unadorned, restrained in style

clue.text: As the flu got a cousin ill

clue.text: Where MP has issues displaying use of force

clue.text: Pure fairy tale

clue.text: Very quick sauce is about right

clue.text: With tip that is endless difficulty, here's another place for rubbish

ie, id est

parts.note: a bind is a difficult situation

clue.text: Hang around, having missed grand cruise ship

G for grand, a thousand pounds
